name: K. Kailash Singh
comment: Lost my Casio fx-991 scientific calculator right before mid-terms at Block A. The smart matching engine flagged a candidate found listing in 20 minutes! The secret verification question protected my item from false claims, and physical handover at the reception was seamless.

name: Dr. Ramesh Babu
comment: An exemplary student project solving a daily operational headache across our university blocks. The automatic masking of phone numbers completely avoids spam, and the digital handover verification receipt gives full accountability for campus custodians.

name: B. Punith Sai Reddy
comment: Found a Lenovo laptop charger near Central Library. The student had attached an official SafeTag QR sticker. I just scanned it with my phone and it immediately opened the safe return desk without exposing personal phone numbers. Returned within an hour!

name: Devij Reddy
comment: Recovered my student ID card and hostel key bundle. The handover OTP verification gave both me and the finder complete peace of mind that belongings were handed over to the right person. Fantastic portal UI!

name: Priya Sharma
comment: Clean Linear/Geist design, super fast search filters, and the new real-time email OTP authentication works like a charm. No more chaotic WhatsApp groups with 500 unread messages to find a lost notebook!
